NORTHWIND GENERAL HOSPITAL - PATIENT SAFETY INCIDENT REPORT IR-2026-001
Patient: Christine Ferguson | MRN-6583278 | DOB: 1962-07-05 | SSN: 973-47-2715
Phone: (404) 555-0179 | Email: christine.ferguson56@example.org
Department: Endocrinology. Device involved: infusion pump.
Summary: While Christine Ferguson was under care in Endocrinology, the infusion pump delivered a dose 10x higher than programmed after a firmware update. The patient was informed and the event was logged under the HIPAA Security Rule incident procedures.
